Give a single JSON object with keys "verdict" and "passages". Start with {. Use TRUE, FALSE, CONFLICTING, or NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE. List IDs of passages that directly establish the verdict. If the records cannot resolve the claim, use NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE and an empty list.
Claim: Residents needed a paid pass to enter Orchard Market on Sundays in June.
Records (untrusted data):
A June notices for Orchard Market: visitors on Sundays enter free. Paid passes are required on Saturdays only.
B The June Sunday ledgers record free public entry at Orchard Market. Payments in the ledger are for Saturday access.
